q: Thermodynamics is the study of systems involving energy in the form of _____.
e: Thermodynamics studies systems whose energy appears as heat and work. A piston confining gas in a cylinder is the usual picture. Radiation from an opaque solid is not scored as a mass phenomenon.

q: When two systems are in thermal equilibrium, there is no net _____ between them.

q: The Zeroth Law states that if two objects are in equilibrium with a third, they are in equilibrium with _____.
e: Zeroth law: if two objects are each in equilibrium with a third, they are in equilibrium with each other. That is how temperature becomes a comparable property. A fourth object is not part of the statement.
